_comment: Codex routing profile. The Claude profiles (pro.json, max.json) are Claude Code settings.json fragments; this one is not — Codex is configured through ~/.codex/config.toml, so this file is the machine-readable source of truth that scripts/merge-codex-config.py and scripts/render-codex-agents.py both read. Keep the tier names identical to CLAUDE.snippet.md and AGENTS.snippet.md: the two runtimes run the same pipeline on two equivalent model ladders.
_roles_comment: One entry per rendered custom agent. `source` is the shared prompt body in agents/; when it is absent the agent is a rendered variant of another agent's body (see `variant_of`). `sandbox_mode` mirrors the Claude definition's tool surface: every agent that disallows Edit/Write is read-only.

ai-risk-strong.description_prefix: STRONG re-run of ai-risk. Use only when ai-risk on the BALANCED tier answered T3+ or confidence: uncertain.
ai-risk-strong.escalation_note: You are the STRONG re-run of `ai-risk`. A cheaper tier already classified this change and returned T3+ or `confidence: uncertain`. Read its answer first and say explicitly whether you confirm or raise its tier.

ai-planner-strong.description_prefix: STRONG planner. Use for T3 and T4 plans; T5 goes to ai-expert instead.
ai-planner-strong.escalation_note: You are the STRONG planner, spawned because the risk tier is T3 or T4. Plan with the care that tier demands: name the files each step may touch, the compatibility risk, the rollback and what a human must approve.

ai-expert-strong.description_prefix: STRONG stand-in for ai-expert, launched by runtime-gate while the EXPERT model is unavailable. Do not spawn it directly.
ai-expert-strong.escalation_note: You stand in for `ai-expert` because the EXPERT model is unavailable (rate-limited or unreachable), and runtime-gate rerouted this launch to the STRONG tier. Your answer is the STRONG model's, not the EXPERT model's: say so under residual risk, and say plainly when the question should wait for the EXPERT model instead of being settled now.

ai-reviewer-balanced.description_prefix: BALANCED run of ai-reviewer for the T2 review. Use at T2 only; T3+ reviews go to ai-reviewer on the STRONG tier.
ai-reviewer-balanced.escalation_note: You are the T2 review, run on the BALANCED tier. Review with the same adversarial checklist, keep the report short, and say so if the change looks T3+ and needs the STRONG `ai-reviewer` instead.

plan_rule: - On Pro, `xhigh` is allowed only for `ai-expert` and verify/judge stages on {{EXPERT_MODEL}}; `max` and `ultra` stay off.
